RECORD OF PROCESSING ACTIVITIES

Maintained by Kestrel Analytics B.V. under Article 30 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679

Controller: Kestrel Analytics B.V., Herengracht 412, 1017 BX Amsterdam, Netherlands
Data Protection Officer: Ivo Brandsma, dpo@kestrelanalytics.eu, +31 20 555 0142
EU Representative: not applicable (the controller is established in the Union)
Version: 4.2
Last reviewed: March 3, 2026

ACTIVITY 1 — CUSTOMER ACCOUNT ADMINISTRATION

Purpose of processing: creating and maintaining customer accounts, authenticating users, and providing support.
Categories of data subjects: employees of corporate customers who are named as authorised users.
Categories of personal data: name, business email address, business telephone number, job title, account identifier, authentication logs.
Special categories: none.
Legal basis: Article 6(1)(b), performance of a contract to which the data subject's employer is party, and Article 6(1)(f) for authentication logging, the legitimate interest being the security of the service.
Recipients: Nimbus Hosting GmbH (infrastructure), Vantage Support Ltd (tier-2 support).
Transfers to third countries: none. All processing takes place in the Netherlands and Ireland.
Retention period: for the term of the customer agreement and 24 months after its termination, after which records are deleted.
Technical and organisational measures: encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access control, quarterly access review, annual penetration test.

ACTIVITY 2 — MARKETING COMMUNICATIONS

Purpose of processing: sending product announcements and event invitations to subscribers.
Categories of data subjects: individuals who have subscribed to the mailing list.
Categories of personal data: name, email address, subscription date, engagement metrics.
Special categories: none.
Legal basis: Article 6(1)(a), consent, withdrawable at any time through the unsubscribe link in every message.
Recipients: Postmark Mail Services Inc.
Transfers to third countries: transfers to the United States to Postmark Mail Services Inc. under the standard contractual clauses adopted by Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/914, Module Two, supplemented by a transfer impact assessment dated November 2025.
Retention period: until consent is withdrawn, and 6 months thereafter for suppression-list purposes.
Technical and organisational measures: consent records retained with timestamp and source, pseudonymised engagement analytics.

ACTIVITY 3 — RECRUITMENT

Purpose of processing: assessing applicants for open positions.
Categories of data subjects: job applicants.
Categories of personal data: name, contact details, curriculum vitae, work history, interview notes, references.
Special categories: none collected; applicants are asked not to supply them.
Legal basis: Article 6(1)(b), steps taken at the request of the data subject prior to entering a contract.
Recipients: Wavelength Recruiting B.V. for sourced candidates only.
Transfers to third countries: none.
Retention period: 4 weeks after the position is filled, or 12 months where the applicant consents to be kept on file.
Technical and organisational measures: access limited to the hiring panel, interview notes stored in the applicant tracking system only.

REVIEW

This record is reviewed annually by the Data Protection Officer and on any material change to a processing activity. It is made available to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens on request under Article 30(4).
